title: Sovra Factory ComponentMaintenance record set (FTF-R017)
description: OSS lifecycle record for each of the seven canonical reuse components (Section 80.4: 'Every selected component and transitive dependency requires approved license/source notices, pinned versions/digests, vulnerability checks, upgrade/rollback tests, provenance and an identified maintainer/operator'). A ComponentMaintenanceSet must record exactly the seven canonical component keys, exactly once each -- the same whole-set discipline FTF-R001's component-lock.schema.json already established. `spdx_license_id` is restricted to a short allow-list of permissive licenses this Factory has actually reviewed; anything else (copyleft, source-available, proprietary) is a real rejection, not a value this schema accepts silently.

approvedSpdxLicenseId.description: Permissive licenses this Factory has actually reviewed and approved for reuse. Section 80.4 forbids a required feature depending on a paid SaaS service or enterprise-only feature without an explicit approved change -- an unreviewed or copyleft/enterprise license is never added here to make a record pass.

license_evidence_url.description: The exact source this license claim was verified against -- never asserted from memory alone.

enterprise_or_proprietary_features_used.description: Structurally false: this Factory reuses each component's open-core/permissively-licensed surface only. Section 80.4 / CLAUDE.md's 'new runtime deps' and 'keyed external services' ask-first items require an explicit owner-approved change before any enterprise/proprietary feature could ever be adopted -- this schema cannot express that approval, so it never accepts `true`.
